Checkpoint fixture
==================

``gbrl_1_1_9.gbrl_model`` was saved by local master at ``f23353a``
using its release CPU build. It has one depth-1 oblivious tree, one numerical
feature, one output, and a constant SGD learning rate of 1.0. Training used
``X = arange(8).reshape(-1, 1)`` and gradients equal to ``X``. Its predictions
are -1.5 for inputs 0 through 3 and -5.5 for inputs 4 through 7.

The fixture is distributed under the repository's MIT license.
